collection.equality: exact complete observations including PNG, SVG, SVG-raster PNG, RGBA, controls and black/white composites

capture.claim: First frame only for these long-duration fixtures within bound; no arbitrary-time or later-disposal claim

codecs: lossy VP8 with ALPH when nonopaque

expectation_policy: Authored source RGBA and two composition hypotheses never changed by browser; lossy RGB canonical is exact browser sample, not source RGB or a tolerance; exact alpha separately recorded

encoder.lossless: WebPEncodeLosslessRGBA(rgba,width,height,stride=width*4,out); simple API defaults; invisible RGB may be discarded
encoder.native_diagnostic: WebPDecodeRGBA; same external libwebp, not an independent codec cross-check
encoder.independence: External C libwebp encoder; no production Rust image-webp encoder/decoder or renderer invoked
encoder.build_provenance: Prebuilt Ubuntu package in digest-pinned OCI; no local compiler or network preparation; OCI pins full runtime closure
